name: code-grown-pet
description: A little companion that hatches and grows as you write and save code in VS Code.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @code-grown-pet/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @code-grown-pet/protocol && npm run build --workspace @code-grown-pet/companion && npm run build --workspace code-grown-pet-extension
